items.escena: A clay girl in the middle of painting a large mural of birds on a school wall, her brush still moving and one long stroke only half finished
A clay boy proudly standing next to a finished sandcastle on a beach, his bucket and spade set down beside it, the work completely done
A clay teenager at a street taco stand freezes mid-bite with wide eyes as a fictional singer in sunglasses, carrying a guitar case, walks past on the sidewalk
A clay family on a living room sofa holding bowls of snacks, their surprised faces lit only by a small flashlight after the television and lamp suddenly go dark in a blackout
A wide view of a small clay bus terminal at dusk: a few travellers with suitcases waiting on benches under warm lamps, an orange sky fading outside the large windows
A clay traveller in a bus terminal reaching out in alarm as her suitcase rolls away on its own down a long ramp toward the parked buses
A clay traveller hugging her recovered suitcase with a big sigh of relief while a kind station worker in a cap smiles beside her
A clay teenager at a café table leaning forward with raised eyebrows and an excited hand gesture, while three friends lean in eagerly to hear what comes next
A clay girl arranging tiny toy figures, a toy bus and a small cardboard building on a café table to show her friends exactly where her story happened
A clay boy hopping across a small river on a row of stepping stones, each stone joined to the next by a short wooden plank
A clay boy who missed his bus sits on his suitcase in the rain looking glum, as a friendly neighbour in a small car pulls up to offer him a ride
A clay audience in a cosy café laughing hard after a story, one person wiping away tears of laughter and another covering her mouth in surprise
